title: Ramp, Garage, Stair and Balcony Tiles: Safe Outdoor Options
excerpt: How to choose grippy, strong tiles for ramps, garages, stairs, balconies and terraces, and what to ask before you buy.
meta_title: Ramp, Garage, Stair and Balcony Tiles Guide
meta_description: Ramp, garage, stair and balcony tiles in Pakistan: textured, outdoor-suited options, base preparation and what to ask your supplier before buying.
answer_box: Safe tiles for ramps, garages, stairs and balconies have a textured or matt face for grip, enough thickness for the load, low water absorption, and a firm sloped base. Avoid glossy polished tiles outdoors, since they turn slippery when wet. Test a wet sample before ordering.
ai_summary: Ramps, garages, stairs and balconies need textured, outdoor-suited tiles with enough thickness for the load and a base that drains. Otti, pavers and natural terracotta are common choices; always test a wet sample. Pak Clay, making clay tiles in Lahore since 1982, offers free samples on WhatsApp.

faqs.question: What tiles are best for a ramp?
faqs.answer: Textured or matt tiles with many joints, such as otti pieces and small pavers, give more grip than smooth glossy tiles. Check the product stated use and test a wet sample.

faqs.question: How much do garage and balcony tiles cost?
faqs.answer: Rates depend on the product, size, thickness and quantity, so there is no single figure. Ask for a written quote showing the unit, the quantity and the date.

faqs.question: Are pavers or terracotta better for a garage?
faqs.answer: Pavers are thicker and made for vehicle areas, while natural terracotta suits porches, terraces and light-use areas. Match the product to the load and ask the supplier.

faqs.question: Can I use glossy tiles on outdoor stairs?
faqs.answer: It is not advised, since glossy surfaces get slippery in rain. Choose matt or textured tiles and make the stair edge easy to see.
